dataSources.name: {device_name}_CARRIL_{carril}
dataSources.selectStatement: SELECT  TOP 1 * FROM "CONTADORESTRAFICO"."dbo"."VIEWDATVEHAGRU_MINUTOS_1_{site}" WHERE CARRIL = {carril}  AND "DATEREG" > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (3/(24.0 * 60.0)) ORDER BY "DATEREG" ASC;

dataSources.name: {device_name}_ALARMAS
dataSources.selectStatement: SELECT TOP 1 * FROM "CONTADORESTRAFICO"."dbo"."VISTAESTADOAFOROS" WHERE NUMSITIO = {site} ORDER BY "FECHACONEXION" DESC;

sstGlobalScripts.name: date_to_timestamp
